name: VAE Decoder for Features
definition: A pre-trained light-weight VAE decoder from LDM used to interpret features. It is a purely convolutional architecture with four upsample blocks, each consisting of two residual blocks.
summary: The VAE Decoder for Features is a light-weight, purely convolutional U-Net that reconstructs RGB images from multi-scale feature maps by integrating downsampled inputs at different stages to preserve spatial details.
